run_profiler_context: use maybe_run_profiler as a context manager to profile a PyTorch training module with xformers
convert_perfetto_to_html: convert a perfetto JSON trace file to an interactive HTML viewer using perfetto_to_html
configure_profiler_args: create a ProfilerArgs dataclass to configure warmup steps and trace folder for profiling
profile_with_wandb_pytorch: use PyTorchProfilerWandb to log PyTorch profiler traces as HTML to Weights and Biases
profile_memory_with_wandb: use MemSnapshotsProfilerWandb to log memory snapshot traces as HTML to Weights and Biases
